value.rationale: The two exact PL fixed-space recursions determine nontrivial geometric fixed spaces in an infinite family of naturally occurring topological spheres, with dimensions that grow with length. They distinguish two commuting geometric and orientation involutions and determine the entire integral rank-one representation plus a sharp mod-eight rational quotient dichotomy. None of these data follow from the published ordinary Betti number alone; the result is a family-level equivariant structural refinement, not an isolated small-case enumeration.
